title: Activation receipts and history
summary: Immutable activation receipts identify one resolved selection, while Registry state records the active history cursor and health pointers. Approval is exact-resolution authorization, not a general grant.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: plan_activation

resolved.description: Canonical frozen ResolvedLuc; public receipt shape is iface:luc.resolver/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline. Computes approval hash bound to previous selection, exact resolution and mode. Profile/receipt corruption can propagate E_LUC_PROFILE_CORRUPT or E_LUC_ACTIVATION_CORRUPT.

operations.name: activate

resolved.description: Canonical frozen ResolvedLuc; public receipt shape is iface:luc.resolver/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline. Same selection reuses immutable receipt and adds no history entry. Exact fresh hash required for expansions; a stale or unnecessary authorization is refused. No live Runtime restart.

operations.name: rollback
operations.notes: No deadline. Every retry moves the cursor backward again; sources remain untouched.

operations.name: redo
operations.notes: No deadline. Every retry moves the cursor forward again.

operations.name: current
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: last_known_good
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: mark_healthy
operations.notes: No deadline. Repeating on the same selected activation naturally records it healthy and pins last-known-good; this is explicit health bookkeeping, not a probe.

operations.name: mark_failed
operations.notes: No deadline. Can select a distinct last-known-good receipt. If none, records failed validation then raises E_LUC_LKG_EMPTY. Retrying with old activation_id may fail because selected activation changed.

invariants.text: Rollback/redo select immutable receipts without reverse-patching sources.
Last-known-good is populated only by explicit mark_healthy, not merely by selection.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: mark_failed and last_known_good have no production Runtime caller. They may restore an earlier layer set, so they are not the self-Luc original-fallback path.
